paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kilayim, chapter 3, end of halakhah 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Kilayim.3.2.4): “The colleagues said before…” etc.
And in [Sanhedrin 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.51b.20): “for the father of Shmuel bar Avin taught.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yerushalmi completes Hyman’s abbreviated phrase: the colleagues speak before Rabbi Shmuel bar Avin.

The linked Sanhedrin passage quotes Shmuel bar Avin’s father, whose own name is not given there. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3379&lang=en) indexes the son and the separate reference to his father.
